body:
# HSRI

We helped HSRI launch an accessible, compliant website through expert audits and troubleshooting—saving time, reducing costs, and earning trust for future projects.

More importantly, they valued that the Aspiritech team, led by Accessibility Project Manager MK Naughton, took the time to untangle some of the more complicated accessibility challenges uncovered in the audit. “They were patient enough to explain terms and things we did not understand,” Solomon says.

### Our Approach

Ran AI-assisted accessibility scans and manual reviews to map high-impact barriers.

Prioritized fixes for critical journeys, then iterated remediation with delivery teams.

Validated improvements through assistive-technology checks and end-to-end usability testing.

Set a repeatable review cadence so new content stays accessible over time.

Aspiritech employs more than 100 experienced testers and more than 90 percent of the team is on the autism spectrum. The team is deeply committed to accessibility in the digital space for all people.
